info.title: eBau eCH API Documentation
info.description:
This document describes the available eBau/ePlan HTTP Services. Almost all services need a valid session and / or authentication. ## Table of Contents * [Login](#login) * [MTLS](#mtls) * [Message Queue](#message-queue) * [Dossier Identification](#dossier-identification) * [Municipality Identification](#municipality-identification) * [Special uses of eCH attributes](#special-uses-of-ech-attributes) * [intendedPurpose](#intendedpurpose) * [Status](#status) * [Messages](#messages) * [General Notes](#general-notes) * [Specific Notes](#specific-notes) * [Messages produced by eBau/ePlan](#messages-produced-by-ebauePlan) * [Messages consumed by eBau](#messages-consumed-by-ebau) * [Extensions](#extensions) * [Suspension](#suspension) * [Proceeding type](#proceeding-type) * [Publication type](#publication-type) * [Documents](#documents) * [UUIDs](#uuids) * [File uploads and document references in eCH messages](#file-uploads-and-document-references-in-ech-messages) * [File downloads](#file-downloads) * [Versioning](#versioning) * [Document categories](#document-categories) * [Other lists/selections/values](#other-listsselectionsvalues) * [Named Meta Data](#named-meta) * [Judgement types](#judgement-types) * [Errors](#errors) ## Login The Ebau TG API requires a valid session token passed in the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header for most operations. [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## MTLS In addition to username/password, access to the production (ebau.tg.ch) and integration/staging (ebau-qs.tg.ch) systems also requires a client-side certificate for mutual TLS. The certificate can be requested from ebau operations/support (TBD), is linked to a specific municipality and has a lifetime of 5 years (or until revoked). [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Message Queue All messages produced by eBau are placed in a message table in the database ('the queue'). They are created when certain events happen in eBau (e.g. a user clicks on 'submit' or a status change is triggered either by the UI or by another source). They are addressed to a specific organisation (i.e. municipality). Each API user is also assigned to a municipality and cann only retrieve messages addressed to that municipality ID. Messages can be fetched either from the start of the queue, or the next message after a specific previously retrieved one can be fetched by passing the id of the last message. In addition, a specific message can be refetched using its ID. [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Dossier Identification The dossier the message is for is extracted from the otherID node that has an idCategory of ebauId: ebauId 142 Since it was unclear when to use otherID and when localID, eBau actually also processes the localID, such that this will also find the same dossier: ebauId 142 The field 'Dossier Nr. Gemeinde' is populated with data from the external systems on receipt of the first 'in progress' status message. The value is extracted from: dossierNrGemeinde FOO42-1337 For synchronisation purposes the currently displayed 'Status' of a dossier on the eBau portal (not necessarily an eCH one) is also adde to the ID properties: ebauDisplayStatus Eingereicht [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Municipality Identification For some possible future use cases (e.g. pass dossier to different municipality) we will need to be able to identify municpalities. We currently use a combination of uidOrganisationIdCategorie (sic) and uidOrganisationId and match it against the UIDs registered in eBau (ignoring . characters): CHE 115081491 is matched to the UID CHE-115.081.491 (Frauenfeld) in eBau. [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Special uses of eCH attributes ### intendedPurpose Both eBau and BOA (the kanton's processing application) use multiple values for 'intended purpose', however eCH only has one occurence of the node in the XML structure. eBau transfers the value as a comma-separated list of (English) strings: * residential_use * commercial_and_industrial_use * agricultural_use * public_use * other_use [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Status The following image depicts the status transitions modelled in eBau TG. Click for full version. ### Notes on the Status Model
  • The status “Building Approval” is not used in the canton of Thurgau.
  • In the canton of Thurgau, the additional statuses “Nachforderung Dokumente (Gemeinde)” and “Request for Additional Documents” are used, which are not provided for in the eCH standard. A building application in the status “Request for Additional Documents” can be edited again and resubmitted by the applicant.
[⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Messages The eCH-0058 messageType in the header is only added for legacy reasons (eCH-0058 requires the node to be present). The values in this node is to be ignored by external systems (in terms of business logic) and it is also completely ignored by eBau/ePlan. For consistency and to possibly make parsing easier/faster, the following table lists the various messageType / event type node combinations: 0058 header messageType | node name of the event in the xml structure | events ---|---|--- 5100000 | eventSubmitPlanningPermissionApplication | submit 5100001 | eventSubmitPlanningPermissionApplication | file subsequently 5100004 | eventAccompanyingReport | accompanying report 5100013 | eventCloseArchiveDossier | close dossier 5100014 | eventCloseArchiveDossier | archive dossier 5100039 | eventNotice | notice ruling 5200000 | eventBaseDelivery | base delivery 5200004 | eventRequest | claim, task, withdraw 5200030 | eventStatusNotification | status notification ### General Notes * There is no direct communication between the BOA and the municipal specialist system. All messages between the canton and the municipal specialist system are transferred via eBau. * The cantonal system BOA cannot display or record remarks, which is why messages to and from the canton can only be transmitted as documents. * The eCH standard does not define message types for 'status notifications', so proprietary values are used here. ### Specific Notes #### Status Messages In eBau Thurgau, statuses can only be set by the municipal building administration system. The applicant has no way of changing the status of the building application themselves (e.g., for construction freeze or suspension) except for submitting or resubmitting documents. #### Deciding and Issuing the Building Application The status messages 'Decision Issued' and 'Decision Legally Binding' must be transmitted separately from the type of decision because there is no event type that can handle both. _Processes_ 1. Decision issued: municipal system sends `notice ruling` & `status notification 'decision issued'` 2. Decision legally binding: municipal system sends `status notification 'decision legally binding'` #### Requesting and Fulfilling Additional Documents Requests for additional documents in eBau are generally fulfilled and transmitted via the municipality, meaning there are no direct requests from the canton to the applicant. _Processes_ 1. Municipality circulates to the canton: `task 12001` 2. Canton requests documents: `claim 05001` → Case 1: 3. Municipality fulfills request directly: `task 12001` → Case 2: 3. Municipality submits request to the applicant: `claim 05001` 5. Applicant fulfills request: `file subsequently` 5. Municipality fulfills request: `task 12001` #### Objections Contrary to the eCH standard, eBau Thurgau allows documents to be attached in the `status notification 'objection pending'`. Objection documents can thus be transmitted to the applicant along with the status notification. ### Messages produced by eBau/ePlan: Deviations from the eCH standard are marked with ⚠️.
Message EventType Message-Type Status Extension Sender Receiver Remark Document Meaning Example
5.1 eventSubmit* submit 11001 - - eBau municipal system ⛔️ ✅ Building application submitted, Status “Baugesuch eingereicht” Example
5.1 eventSubmit file subsequently 07001 eBau municipal system Documents submitted subsequently by the applicant to the municipality. Example
5.2 eventRequest claim 05001 - - (BOA** ->) eBau municipal system ⛔️ ⚠️ ✅ Request for additional documents from the canton to the municipality. The request is transmitted as a PDF document. Example
5.2 eventRequest task 12003 - - eBau municipal system ✅ ✅ Notification from applicant to the municipality (Generic message from the applicant, also for reporting construction processes) Example
5.2 eventRequest task 12006 - - (BOA ->) eBau municipal system ⛔️ ⚠️ ✅ Notification from the canton to the municipality. Notifications are transmitted as PDF documents. Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10101 ⚠️ submitted - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Sent when applicant submits a PPA (after submit). Example
5.9 eventAccompanyingReport accompanying report 01001 - - (BOA ->) eBau municipal system ⛔️ ⚠️ ✅ Report from the canton. The reports are transmitted as pdf-documents. The <ech-0211:judgement> node contains a value from the 'judegment types' list (see further below). Example
5.11 baseDelivery - - - - eBau municipal system ⛔️ ✅ Complete data delivery Example
### Messages consumed by eBau
Message EventType Message-Type Status Extension Sender Receiver Remark Document Meaning Example
5.1 eventSubmit* submit TBD - - municipal system eBau ⛔️ ⛔️ Register a "paper dossier".
  • Do not send documents
  • Include municipality UID (see Named Meta Data and municipality_uids.csv)
  • Must have a dossierIdentification in planningPermissionApplicationIdentification
  • Must have an dossierNrGemeinde in planningPermissionApplicationIdentification (localId or otherId)
 Example
5.2 eventRequest claim 05001 - - municipal system eBau ✅ ✅ Request for additional documents from the municipality to the applicant. Example
5.2 eventRequest task 12001 - - municipal system eBau (-> BOA) ⛔️ ⚠️ ✅ Transmission to the canton & fulfillment of requests by the municipality towards the canton. “Remarks” cannot be displayed in the cantonal system and should therefore not be used. Example
5.2 eventRequest task 12002 - - municipal system eBau ✅ ✅ Notification from the municipality (to applicant) Example
5.2 eventRequest task 12100 - publicationType municipal system eBau ✅ ✅ Start a new publication for a BG or edit/replace an existing one. Example
5.2 eventRequest task 12101 - - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Remove/destroy all publications for a given BG. Example
5.3 eventNotice notice ruling 09003 - - municipal system eBau ✅ ⚠️ ✅ Building application ruling. The remark must be provided in the <ruling> element (see “some kind of text“ in the sample XML). Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10102 ⚠️ in progress proceeding type ⚠️ municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Confirm receipt and set building application to “in process”. Within the notification, the municipal building application number and the procedure type can also be communicated. The procedure type is communicated within the extension. This is also used to lift the statuses “objection pending” and “suspended.” Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10103 ⚠️ withdrawn - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Baugesuch zurückgezogen”. Can only be set by the municipality. Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10104 ⚠️ suspended - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Baugesuch sistiert”. Can only be set by the municipality. Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10106 ⚠️ objection pending - municipal system eBau ✅ ✅ ⚠️ Status “Einsprache eingegangen”. Objection received. Attaching documents is allowed contrary to the eCH standard. Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10108 ⚠️ appellant process - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Rechtsmittelverfahren laufend” Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10109 ⚠️ decision legally binding - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Entscheid rechtskräftig” Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10110 ⚠️ under construction - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Bauvorhaben im Bau” Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10111 ⚠️ building freeze - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Baueinstellung” Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10113 ⚠️ dossier closed - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Dossier geschlossen”. Use either this or eventCloseArchiveDossier, the effects are the same. Example
5.4 eventStatusNotification status notification 10112 ⚠️ dossier archived - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Status “Dossier archived. Use either this or eventCloseArchiveDossier, the effects are the same. Example
5.5 eventCloseArchiveDossier close dossier 06001 - - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Notification that the dossier will be closed. Status “Dosser geschlossen” Example
5.5 eventCloseArchiveDossier archive dossier 03001 - - municipal system eBau ✅ ⛔️ Notification that the dossier will be archived. Status “Dossier archiviert” Example
* short for _eventSubmitPlanningPermissionApplication_ ** BOA: cantonal system 'Bau- und Ortsplanungs-Applikation' [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Extensions The following extensions can be used. They were created for the interaction with the kanton's BOA system. ### Suspension (used only on Kanton-side of API, kept here for reference and possible future use) In order to deal with several suspensions happening in parallel, they can be identified. However, these suspensions must be individually cancelled using the same extensions in subsequent 'In Progress' status notifications. If only an 'on/off' approach is used, this extension is not required. eBau/ePlan itself only uses the on/off approach when passing information on to third party systems, i.e. this extension is only read, not written. COO.2187.9900.3.972269 2023-05-01T00:00:00.000+02:00 2023-05-02T00:00:00.000+02:00 ### Proceeding type Ordinary procedure The following values are currently understood/accepted by eBau: * Ordinary procedure * Simplified procedure ### Publication type Klick on "Show Extension..." below to see the full XML structure.
Show extension XML
[⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Documents ### UUIDs eBau/ePlan assigns RFC 4122 Version 7 uuids to documents created in the application (upload via UI). If a document provided by an external source (API,BOA, ...) has a valid uuid, that uuid will be assigned to the document, otherwise a new one will be generated. see https://uuid.ramsey.dev/en/stable/rfc4122.html ### File uploads and document references in eCH messages **Uploads via API are limited to 100MB, the eBau UI limits file sizes to 50MB** In order to prevent duplicate identical files, the following mechanism is used when transferring files to eBau from external systems: 1. Upload file to endpoint: If a UUID is provided and unique, the document is stored with that UUID. 1. If no UUID is provided, eBau checks if a file currently associated with the planning permission application has the same hash. If so, then eBau assumes it is a duplicate, ignores the upload and returns the UUID of the existing document. 1. If a UUID of an existing document is provided, but the hash of the new file does not match the existing one, then a new version of the existing document is created with the new file and the UUID (identical) is returned. 1. Reference documents in eCH messages: In subsequent messages to eBau (via send), documents need to be referenced by providing their UUID Example: 018bcdcb-9dc0-73b0-a9af-9e6b95fa9443 ignored ignored ignored ignored ### File downloads Files are downloaded with a GET request to the file endpoint, using the document's id (integer) or uuid (string) instead of the dossier id (as in the upload case). If the ID provided is a valid UUID, the UUID will be used to retrieve the document, else it will be searched by ID (numeric). e.g. https://ebau.tg.ch/api/v1/file/123 will fetch the file with the ID 123, whereas https://ebau.tg.ch/api/v1/file/foo-bar-baz will fetch the file with the UUID 'foo-bar-baz' (assuming that is actually valid here...), ignoring the ID. Both cases require read access to that file to be granted to the user. ### Versioning If an upload is made providing an existing UUID with a new file (hash), then the file is replaced for that document and the version number of that document record is incremented by one. The old content is stored in a separate version. This way the UUID and the internal ID remain constant for that specific document, even though the content may change (e.g. signed version). Documents in eCH messages generated by eBau/ePlan include version and hash data. Documents with no version are assigned version nr. 0. Example: 89 foo.docx created http://localhost:9023/webroot/api/api/v1/file/89 application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document 0 65ea3daedbaa8d935a6d0c81420f87b41fdf1b81e75ee799bb4f201a978cdac1 sha256 decision_ruling ### Document categories Documents uploaded via the UI are often assigned a category. This category is passed on in the messages generated by ebau in a ech-0147T0:documentKind node. The main purpose for this has been to place the documents in the right 'bucket' for Planungsgesch$ft objects in the management system of the kanton (BOA) when submitting from ePlan. The category cannot be set or changed over the public api. eBau (and ePlan) uses the following categories for documents: *DocumentKind in eBau* | *Document categories in BOA* ---|--- rechtsverbindliche_plaene | Rechtsverbindliche Pläne ergaenzende_plaene | Ergänzende Pläne rechtsverbindliche_berichte | Rechtsverbindliche Berichte ergaenzende_berichte | Ergänzende Berichte richtungsweisende_inhalte | Richtungsweisende Inhalte vorschriften | Vorschriften tabelle | Tabelle fotos | Fotos weitere_unterlagen | Weitere Unterlagen formulare | Formulare planungsbericht | Planungsbericht vorschriften_reglement | Vorschriften Reglement plan | Plan bericht | Bericht begleitschreiben | Begleitschreiben ergaenzende_unterlagen | Ergänzende Unterlagen shelter_control | Shelter Control decision_ruling | Decision Ruling projektunterlagen | Projektunterlagen situationsplan_katasterplan | Situationsplan/Katasterplan entscheid_bewilligung | Entscheid (Bewilligung) und bewilligte Pläne [⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Other lists/selections/values ### Named Meta Data The following namedMetaData blocks are provided within :

[⬆ Back to top](#top) ### Judgement types eBau uses the following judgement type values in <ech-0211:decisionRuling> (notice ruling) as well as the <ech-0211:judgement> (accompanying report) elements.
transmitted eCH value display value eBau counts as approved
Positivebewilligtyes
Positive with conditionsbewilligt mit Vorbehaltyes
non-approval of introductionNicht eintretenno
rejectedabgelehntno
[⬆ Back to top](#top) ## Errors In order to get through the AFI-TG-WAF application errors are returned with a 400 code. The specific error code and message can be taken from the 'error' object in the response JSON. The WAF also converts 403 responses into HTML. Thus access denied errors are also returned with an HTTP 400 code. **Error Codes:** Code | German text ---|--- 104 | Kein Baugesuch mit der ID gefunden: <ID> 123 | Datenbank Fehler 404 | Zugriff verweigert 1000 | Unbekannter Status: <Status-Bezeichnung> 1001 | Statusübergang nicht erlaubt: <alter Status> -> <neuer Status> 2001 | Ungültige Daten für Sistierung 3001 | Ungültige Daten für Entscheid 4001 | Ungültiger Input für ein Submit 4002 | Ungültiger Input für Publikation [⬆ Back to top](#top)
